notes: The embedded object-operation table labels type 8 SHADOW_ON. Its dispatcher restores the selected object's shadow rendering, making this the inverse of command 24 hide_selected_object_shadow. The JP corpus contains 134 calls, and command 21 show_object immediately precedes every one.
